data.description:
## Problem
CloudWatch alarm rebar-bridge-run-failures entered ALARM at 2026-11-03 11:41 PST. Scheduled reconcile-bridge runs 41693706227 (10:25 PST), 41703055677 (11:25 PST) and 41712353911 (12:24 PST) all failed the same way; 17:24Z and earlier runs passed.

Each failing run dies in rebar.reconciler._ref_lock: git cat-file blob 36823c918daf:lock.json timed out after 5.0s, raised RefLockTimeoutError, and the pass lock fails CLOSED (ReconcileLockError: cannot determine pass-lock state). The lock ref itself shows released=True, fence 5, written 2026-11-03 09:42:30 PST.

## Evidence for the cause (one experiment, not yet proven in CI)
The workflow checks out with filter: blob:none, and the 'Sync reconciler lock refs' step fetches refs/reconciler/* under that inherited partial-clone filter, so lock.json is not local and cat-file triggers a lazy promisor fetch over the network. The ref-lock primitive's 5 s timeout was specified for LOCAL object/ref ops (pony-ditch-armor; 30 s is the remote budget). In a fresh blobless clone on the operator host, the first cat-file of that blob took 4.44 s; the cached repeat took 0.02 s. Unchecked: why it started failing at 10:25 PST rather than earlier.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The lock blob is local before the ref-lock reads it in the bridge workflow (e.g. fetch refs/reconciler/* with its blobs), or the read is classified and budgeted as a remote op; a test reproduces the lazy-fetch read and pins the fix.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The next scheduled reconcile-bridge run after the merge succeeds and publishes bridge_run_failures=0.
  provenance: production-equivalent / live-call
- [ ] [non-codebase] rebar-bridge-run-failures returns to OK.
  provenance: production-equivalent / live-call
data.title: Bridge pass lock read times out on blobless CI checkout
